messages:
Sofia: New request from Beacon Analytics: they want a guarded onboarding path + a "retrofit stability" option that keeps model outputs within an "entropy budget" for 60 days. Need to define bench, pin semantics, and deprecation commitments.
Ben: "Entropy budget" is new wording but useful. We should define it: allowable change in output distribution measured via KL-divergence on seeded prompts + a downstream metric (e.g., top-k rerank).
Ivy: Operational asks: they want a 3-step canary-as-a-service flow (shadow mirror -> soft-canary -> ramp) with configurable gates. Propose default gates: KL-divergence <= 0.02, quality_regression_rate <= 1.0%, p95_latency_delta <= 150ms.
Kofi: Bench proposal: "retrofit-stability-mini" suite, 2.2k prompts (customer seeds + canonical probes). Pass if KL <= 0.02 AND rerank_p@10 delta >= -0.01 AND p95_latency_delta <= 150ms. Allow two remediation runs.
Sofia: Draft bench snippet for clarity:
```
bench_name: retrofit-stability-mini
sample_count: 2200
metrics:
  - kl_divergence_on_seeded_prompts
  - rerank_p10_delta
  - p95_latency_ms_delta
pass_criteria:
  - kl_divergence_on_seeded_prompts <= 0.02
  - rerank_p10_delta >= -0.01
  - p95_latency_ms_delta <= 150
reporting: per-route + token/latency breakdown
```
Ben: Pin semantics: call it a "conditional softpin": catalog entry locked for 60 days by default, but Redwood can apply emergency-safety patches. Any other changes require a 10-day notice and an opt-in. On customer approval we can apply migration shims.
Ivy: Canary flow: shadow 10% for 48h, then 2% live -> 20% -> 60% over 72h. Auto-rollback triggers: KL > 0.02 OR quality_regression_rate > 1.0% OR p95_latency_delta > 150ms.
Kofi: For commercial smoothing: offer 15% onboarding credit and hold a small "rollback-escrow" of 200k tokens to cover potential revert traffic. If escrow exhausted, we bill at migration rate. Eng-platform to track escrow.
eng-platform-bot: INFO: Canary template "canary-as-service-v3" available. Rollback-escrow ledger requires feature flag (#FR-5203).
Sofia: Deprecation / migration path: 1) softpin auto-expires, 2) 30-day graduated deprecation window with staged comms (notice, recommended migration, final deprecate), 3) customers in softpin get a migration credit if we require forced move due to safety.
Ben: If bench fails after two remediation runs, policy: pause onboarding and offer a paid migration engagement or revert to previous model. Product to draft escalation playbook.
Ivy: Ownership: Eng-ML runs bench + certifies metrics; Product curates seeds and customer acceptance; Eng-Platform builds canary pipelines and escrow accounting; Legal drafts softpin & deprecation clause.
Legal Bot: REMINDER: Clause must define "conditional softpin", emergency-patch carve-outs, escrow accounting, notice periods, and audit trails. Also include data-residency and export-control confirmations.
Sofia: Next steps: 1) Eng-ML to run initial bench by Wed EOD. 2) Eng-Platform to validate canary template and escrow support. 3) Legal to draft clause in 3 business days. 4) Product to prepare SOW + migration credit examples. Will post bench results here. :white_check_mark:
Ben: One more: record model binary hash + quant profile + seed set snapshot with bench report for future dispute resolution.
Sofia: Noted 7 will include artifacts and a small dashboard mock showing KL and rerank delta per route. Thanks all.
